answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a physical relic token whose tamper-evident cipher is rekeyed per epoch, so cloned credentials fail verification before any value transfers. Honest agents may wander across many pseudonyms, but each must periodically prove possession of its unique relic, collapsing sybil clusters into a single costly identity. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
